subject: pathology
title: Metabolic liver disease and hepatic tumours

steps.tx: **Non alcoholic fatty liver** (insulin resistance, ballooning with lobular inflammation grading NASH activity) and **alcoholic liver disease** (central **Mallory hyaline** with neutrophilic satellitosis, chicken wire fibrosis, AST double ALT) both march steatosis to cirrhosis; abstinence with weight loss reverses early stages. **Hereditary haemochromatosis** (**C282Y** HFE, **bronze diabetes** with arthropathy of second and third MCPs, hypogonadism, cardiomyopathy, ferritin with high transferrin saturation, hepatic iron index) is treated with **phlebotomy**; secondary overload (thalassaemia transfusions) needs chelation. Fibroscan stages all.
steps.say: AST double ALT with Mallory is alcoholic. Bronze skin with diabetes and MCP pain is haemochromatosis: bleed it.

steps.tx: **Wilson disease** (ATP7B copper excretion failure, **Kayser-Fleischer rings**, low ceruloplasmin, high urinary copper, Coombs negative haemolysis with parkinsonism and dysarthria in youth) is treated with **penicillamine or trientine** (zinc blocks absorption, transplant fulminant); siblings screen. **Alpha 1 antitrypsin deficiency** (PiZZ, **PAS diastase resistant globules**, neonatal cholestasis, early panacinar emphysema, panniculitis) is managed supportively with augmentation debates. **Primary biliary cholangitis** (middle aged women, **anti mitochondrial M2**, pruritus with xanthelasma, ursodiol) differs from PSC (men, IBD, beading, cholangiocarcinoma risk).
steps.say: Young parkinsonism with brown corneal rings is Wilson: chelate copper. PASD globules with early emphysema are A1AT.

steps.tx: **Hepatocellular carcinoma** (HBV, HCV cirrhosis, alcohol, aflatoxin, **rising AFP**) is diagnosed radiologically: **arterial enhancement with portal venous washout** on triple phase CT or MRI (LI-RADS) with threshold growth; biopsy reserved for atypical lesions. **Milan criteria** (single under 5 cm or three under 3 cm, no vascular invasion or spread) gate transplant; resection suits noncirrhotic or preserved function, ablation bridges small lesions, **sorafenib or lenvatinib** with immunotherapy palliates advanced. Six monthly ultrasound with AFP surveils cirrhosis.
steps.say: Arterial blush washing out venously is HCC: Milan gates transplant. Cirrhosis images twice yearly.

vis.alt: Triple phase CT or MRI showing hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) with characteristic arterial enhancement and portal venous washout.
vis.caption: HCC: Arterial enhancement, portal venous washout on triple phase imaging

steps.tx: **Cholangiocarcinoma** (PSC, **Clonorchis**, choledochal cysts, Thorotrast history, **CA19-9** with painless progressive jaundice and pruritus) is staged by Bismuth-Corlette hilar extent; resection with Roux-en-Y or transplant protocols suit selected hilar disease while stenting palliates. **Benign lesions** (haemangioma with peripheral nodular enhancement, **FNH** with central scar, adenoma with bleeding risk in OCP users needing resection) spare surgery mostly. Klatskin hilar tumours obstruct early; intrahepatic masses mimic HCC without washout.
steps.say: Painless progressive jaundice with CA19-9 is cholangiocarcinoma. Central scar is FNH: observe.
